examples.arabic: النهاردة عيلتي بتاكل الغدا مع بعض
examples.english: Today my family is eating lunch together.
examples.transliteration: El naharda eilty betakul el ghada ma baad

examples.arabic: احنا اكلنا الغدا سوا والاكل كان حلو
examples.english: We ate lunch together and the food was good.
examples.transliteration: ehna akalna el ghada sawa wa el akl kan helw

examples.arabic: النهارده نزلنا انا وامي سوق الخضار عشان نجهز غدا العيلة
examples.english: Today my mother and I went down to the vegetable market to prepare the family lunch.
examples.transliteration: El-naharda nezelna ana wa ommi soo' el-khodar ashan negahez ghada el-eila.

examples.english: We eat lunch together at noon
examples.transliteration: ehna benakol elghada sawa el dohr

examples.arabic: العيله قاعده مع بعض عشان الغدا
examples.english: The family is sitting together for lunch.
examples.transliteration: el eila aada maa baad ashan el ghada

examples.english: We eat lunch at three o'clock.
examples.transliteration: eHna benakol el ghada el sa3a talata
